create_llm_dummy_weights: create an LLM instance with dummy weights using load_format='dummy' for fast engine initialization
run_generate_with_sampling_params: run the LLM generate method with prompts and SamplingParams to produce text outputs
update_config_collective_rpc: update the LLM load configuration in-place via collective_rpc with 'update_config' method
reload_weights_collective_rpc: reload real model weights in-place on the LLM engine via collective_rpc with 'reload_weights'
print_prompts_and_outputs: print prompts and generated text outputs from a list of RequestOutput objects
